'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Emil Wallin DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Day 3 Dark is the same as the Day 2 Imperial Entanglements list, with the substitutions written on the Day 3 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time (Virtual Block 1)|VB1-D-imperialentanglements-pre.gif|label=Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time}}
* '''Username:''' Darth-Link
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
